statement_en: Every complex $n\times n$ matrix $A$ is unitarily similar to an upper triangular matrix $T$, that is, there exists a unitary matrix $Q$ such that $$A=QTQ^{\dagger},$$ and the diagonal entries of $T$ are the eigenvalues of $A$.
final_code:
import Mathlib

theorem schurTriangularization
    (n : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    ∃ Q T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ,
      Matrix.IsUpperTriangular T ∧
      A = Q * T * Matrix.conjTranspose Q ∧
      Q * Matrix.conjTranspose Q = 1 ∧
      Matrix.conjTranspose Q * Q = 1 ∧
      ∀ i : Fin n, Polynomial.IsRoot (Matrix.charpoly A) (T i i) := by
  sorry
